tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Every section sits on it unless it needs separation.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: cards, nav bar, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: code blocks, table headers, the selected tab track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons). 3.2:1 or better on canvas, surface and sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (16:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: leads, descriptions, captions on canvas, surface, surface-sunken (6.2:1+).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, helper text, placeholders on canvas, surface, surface-sunken (4.5:1+). Not for paragraphs.

tokens.name: ion
tokens.usage: The brand accent: primary buttons, links, active states, focus ring. Text in ion is readable on canvas, surface and sunken (5.1:1+).

tokens.name: ion-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything filled or written in ion.

tokens.name: ion-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected rows, info badges, active nav pill. Put ink or ion text on it.

tokens.name: on-ion
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ion or ion-hover fill (5.9:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: flux
tokens.usage: Secondary accent, used sparingly: 'New' badges, chart highlight, the one hot spot on a page. Fill or mark only; text on it is on-flux.

tokens.name: flux-ink
tokens.usage: Flux as text (5.1:1+ on canvas, surface).

tokens.name: on-flux
tokens.usage: Text on a flux fill (5.9:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons on canvas and surface. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners; success or ink text on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution status text and icons on canvas and surface. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and banners; warning or ink text on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive actions, invalid field borders. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error badges and banners; danger or ink text on it.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted bands: footer, announcement bar, code-heavy hero. Pair with inverse-ink.

tokens.name: inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Text on inverse (17:1).

tokens.name: inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on inverse (8:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: inverse-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside an inverse band.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, once per page. Steps down to display-l under 720px.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Sub-section titles, feature-card titles on wide layouts.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles, timeline entries, dialog titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Deploy from git in under a minute, with previews for every pull request.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Requests are routed to the nearest of 38 regions.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Helper text, table cells, footer links.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, nav links, form labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above section titles, badge text, version tags.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, code blocks, terminal output.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Figures in tables and spec rows; always tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button inline padding (small); list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default component padding; minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap in card grids.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: gutter-min
tokens.usage: Smallest page side gutter (phones).

tokens.name: gutter-max
tokens.usage: Largest page side gutter (desktop); fluid between the two.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Height of the top nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, inline code, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, code blocks, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature panels and the hero media frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and the segmented-control thumb only. Buttons are not pills.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and resting cards that sit on canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, dropdown menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the hero product shot only.

meta.note: Structure (token families, scale steps, component inventory) extracted from both sites; palette, type and radii redesigned for a modern tech brand.
